name: Restrain
source:
Thanks to a friend's connections, the protagonist sneak in the mansion of an extremely rich person as a butler.

Every day, while doing his job as a butler properly, he approaches the women of the mansion to grasp their weakness. His goal is to rape them.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20011031025046fw_/http://www.spielsoft.co.jp/res_index.htm]official website[/url]]
